CustomField.description: Field auto-populates with the Sponsor_Keyword__c value from the Account but is editable. Follows same validation rule requirements.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Keywords are used to search for drives on RCB.org. Maximum 50 characters, not required to be unique; not case sensitive; excludes numbers; 'and', 'or', 'left', 'right' as standalone words; special characters.
CustomField.label: Drive Keyword
